_: monster contracts (the list of 2026-11-20's thirteenth phase, idea 5; 939_contracts15.py). Each wild town's board posts per_board of these beasts (by the town's hash): kind the monster's name on brokenspire, hp its health's factor, tier_up tiers over its lair's land, weakness what the three signs teach (it then takes weak_share more from her blows), offer the board's words, signs the three signs on the way to its lair, read in order of the way. gold: the bounty at tier 1, 35 % more a tier

beasts.name: The Gloamhound
beasts.weakness: it guards its left flank, where an old spear wound never closed
beasts.offer: A hound the size of a pony takes sheep by night and was seen dragging a shepherd.
signs: Paw prints wide as a plate, sunk deep: the beast is heavy, and it limps.
A sheep's carcass, opened from the left: it turns to bite on its right side only.
A broken spearhead in the mud, black with old blood: its left flank was pierced long ago.

beasts.name: Old Quillmaw
beasts.weakness: its belly is soft under the scales, bared when it rears
beasts.offer: Something armoured digs under the fences and takes the goats. Arrows glance off it.
signs: Burrows torn under a fence, and scales shed in the dirt, hard as iron.
A goat's horn snapped clean: it rears to strike, then rolls.
Pale belly-hair caught on a thorn bush at the height of a man's knee: soft, where the scales end.

beasts.name: The Bog Troll of the Mere
beasts.weakness: fresh cuts do not close on it while its hide is dry
beasts.offer: A troll waylays carts on the low road and has killed two drovers.
signs: Footprints a yard long, filled with water: it keeps to the wet.
A cart smashed, and a troll's blood dried to scab on the wheel: its wounds close in the wet.
Its old bed of reeds, left to dry: where it dries out, it heals no more.

beasts.name: Silkwidow
beasts.weakness: its joints are thin where the legs meet the body
beasts.offer: Travellers vanish on the forest track. Webs as thick as rope hang between the trees.
signs: Webs strung across the track at a man's height, sticky and fresh.
A wrapped body in the branches, and a leg shed with the moult: its joints are thin.
Its moulted skin, split at the joints: strike where the legs meet the body.

beasts.name: Redclaw
beasts.weakness: it overreaches when it leaps, and its neck is open
beasts.offer: A raptor gone wild from a lord's stable runs down riders on the plains.
signs: Three-toed tracks far apart: it runs, and leaps.
A horse brought down by the neck in one bound: it leaps at the throat.
A rider's broken lance with feathers on its point: the beast leapt onto it, and its neck was bared.

beasts.name: The Carrion King
beasts.weakness: its shell is cracked across the back from an old fall
beasts.offer: A beetle the size of a wagon feeds on the dead of the battlefields, and lately on the living.
signs: Bones picked clean and a trail of slime: it eats what others kill.
A fallen rock with chips of black shell under it: it fell from the scarp.
A shard of its back plate, split through: its shell is cracked across the back.
